title: im2col for Convolutions
signature: def im2col(x: np.ndarray, kh: int, kw: int, stride: int = 1, pad: int = 0) -> np.ndarray
hints: Pad first: np.pad(x, ((0, 0), (0, 0), (pad, pad), (pad, pad))). Then out_h = (H + 2*pad - kh) // stride + 1.
For each kernel offset (i, j), the slice xp[:, :, i : i + stride*out_h : stride, j : j + stride*out_w : stride] has shape (N, C, out_h, out_w).
Stack those slices into an array of shape (N, C, kh, kw, out_h, out_w), transpose to (C, kh, kw, N, out_h, out_w), then reshape.
